b.body: Branch managers plan which staff work at the issue desk each day.

a.title: Overdue fines
a.body: A fine of 20 cents per day is added for each overdue book.

b.title: Newsletter sign-up
b.body: Members can subscribe to the monthly events newsletter.

a.title: Search the catalogue
a.body: Members can search the books by title, author or subject.

b.title: Report a broken computer
b.body: Members can report a faulty public computer, and the IT team is notified.

a.title: Borrowing limit
a.body: A member can have at most 10 items on loan at once.

b.title: Photo on the membership card
b.body: Members can upload a photo to be printed on their library card.

a.title: Due date reminder
a.body: Members get an email 3 days before a loan is due back.

b.title: Archive access log
b.body: Every request to view the local history archive is logged with the reader's name.

a.title: Self-checkout kiosk
a.body: Members can borrow books by scanning their card and the book at a kiosk.

b.title: Volunteer registration
b.body: People can apply online to volunteer at a branch.

a.title: Reading history
a.body: Members can see a list of everything they have borrowed, and can turn the history off.

b.title: Branch opening hours page
b.body: The website shows each branch's opening hours and its holiday closures.
